item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy, json\\nfrom work import evaluate\\np={'base_unit':'m','units':{'m':1,'cm':0.01},'unique':True}\\ncases=[\\n({'rows':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':300,'unit':'cm'}]}, {'ok':True,'records':[{'id':'a','amount':2},{'id':'b','amount':3.0}],'errors':[]}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'','amount':-1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':True},{'id':'a','amount':1,'unit':'bad'},{'id':'a','amount':1},{'id':'a','amount':2}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'id'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'unit'},{'row':4,'cause':'duplicate'}]}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'x','amount':float('inf')},{'id':'y','amount':float('nan')},{'id':'z','amount':-0.1}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'},{'row':1,'cause':'amount'},{'row':2,'cause':'amount'}]}),\\n({'rows':[{'id':'q','amount':-1},{'id':'q','amount':2}]}, {'ok':False,'records':[],'errors':[{'row':0,'cause':'amount'}]})]\\nfor i,(req,expected) in enumerate(cases):\\n before=copy.deepcopy(req); got=evaluate(req,p); assert got==expected,(i,got,expected); assert req==before\\nprint(json.dumps({'passed':len(cases),'observations':[evaluate({'rows':[]},p),evaluate({'rows':[{'id':'k','amount':0,'unit':'cm'}]},p)]}))\"]}"}
